_comment: Pretraining hyperparameters for Model L (Nepali). Identical to the other language's, so any difference in the learning curves reflects the corpus rather than the schedule.
_token_budget: 16,000 steps x 32,768 tokens = 524,288,000 tokens, 0.73 of one pass over this language's 716,450,642-token training split. That is close to the compute-optimal ~20 tokens per parameter for a 24.3M-parameter model, and it means no document is seen twice.
_batch_note: tokens_per_step is the quantity held fixed; micro_batch_size is only a memory knob. On a smaller GPU, halve micro_batch_size and gradient accumulation doubles automatically, leaving the effective batch and the learning dynamics unchanged.
_lr_note: 6e-4 peak with 500 warmup steps. A 25M model can often take 1e-3, but this project gets one training run per language with no budget for a restart, so the more conservative and well-trodden value was chosen.
_checkpoint_note: Every 1,000 steps. Kaggle terminates sessions at twelve hours and can pre-empt sooner, so this bounds the work lost to an interruption to a few minutes.
